title: Estimation Problems and the Modulating Function Method: The Algebra of Modulating Functions
summary: The modulating function method is an algebraic estimation framework that has been used for state and parameter estimation, as well as fault detection, of linear and some nonlinear systems. At the core of the method is the modulating function: a function that evaluates to 0 at the left or right boundaries up to a certain order of derivatives, being classified as left, right, or total modulating functions.
